summary.text: Dan Fister is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 56 since 2021 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as Daniel Fister and gives his profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Dan Fister, listed by Ballotpedia as Daniel Fister, was born in Lexington, Kentucky, and graduated from Lexington Catholic High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in accounting from Eastern Kentucky University.
His career experience includes working as a property manager, serving as a deputy with the Fayette County jailer, and founding a construction contracting business.
Fister assumed office on January 1, 2021, succeeding Joe Graviss (D).

In the 2025-2026 session he was vice chair of the House Agriculture Committee and also served on the Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations and Small Business & Information Technology committees.
